title: Settings list in the Você tab
summary: The Configurações section of the Você tab (ADR 0112): one row per settings group, each with its current state as the subtitle, so the list reads as a summary. Rows and their order come from registries/settings.json root.

key.description: The group key in registries/settings.json root, in that order.

subtitle.description: The state line of the group (see notes). Absent when the group has none.

warning.description: true only for account when it has one or no ways back. The only warning badge in Settings.

rows.description: From the generated settings code (BipeSettings), root order.

appear.effect: Reads the values the subtitles need: GET /v1/me/account (ways back), the who-can-message setting, the notification state on this phone, Encryption.recoveryState and the synced token.

openGroup.effect: Opens settings-group for that key; notifications opens notification-settings (bipe-chat/bipe#565).

notes: Subtitles: privacy from the who-can-message value (bipe_settings_privacy_summary_*); account from the ways-back count (bipe_settings_account_paths with the count, or bipe_settings_account_paths_none and the warning); notifications from notification-settings (on, or off on this phone). chats and help have none.

Ways back are counted on the device: confirmed recovery e-mail, linked Apple or Google account, recovery key set up, recovery token synced. One or none sets warning. Bipe logic: BipeWaysBack (iOS BipeSettingsSupport.swift), BipeWayBack (Android settings/).
The Você tab shows no warning mark for ways back (ADR 0112, MZ 21 Oct 2026); the tab icon carries only the other-account dot (ADR 0135).
The header, account switcher, Anotações, trust profile card and Convidar pessoas above this section are people and profiles (bipe-chat/bipe#567) and groups (#569).
A new top-level group needs a new ADR (registries/settings.json).
